project.name: Nestor Orchestration Engine
project.summary: Nestor is a high-performance, memory-optimized workflow engine in C utilizing a custom virtual machine (NVM) and chained arena allocator.

task.objective: Complete Phase 2: Full Nestor VM (NVM) Implementation (Next Milestone)
task.current_task: Prepare next agent to implement all remaining NVM opcodes, step processing, scoped variables, caching, and state serialization in nvm.c to fully replace the DAG runner.
next_steps: Implement all control flow instructions in src/comm/struct/nvm.c (OP_FORK, OP_JOIN, switch routing, conditional edges, error fallbacks).
Integrate non-blocking curl_multi and plugin runners into NVM steps execution.
Implement evaluation-stack scoped variables lookup and sub-arenas loop memory compaction in nvm.c.
Implement SQLite cache querying and tfstate lock checking in VM runs.
Implement NVM state serialization to .tfstate and resuming on signals.
success_criteria: All VM tests pass and NVM successfully executes arbitrary workflow scenarios.
All E2E and unit tests pass when VM is set as the default execution engine in main.c.
do_not_modify: The custom chained arena memory management laws must not be broken (no stdlib malloc/free).
Standard folding syntax /*#region*/ and /*#endregion*/ must be strictly preserved.

completed: Stage 10: Multi-format XML/CSV/YAML/Form/Binary transcoders and registration in JSONata.
Stage 11: CLI context inspection via plan --show-context and compile-time path verification via schema_sample.
Created transcoder.test.c and updated USAGE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, IMPLEMENTATION.md, PROGRESS.md, and ROADMAP.md.

documentation.purpose: Details system design and specifies the VM as the default runtime engine.
Provides technical implementation details and zero-copy JSON IR specification.
Instruction Set Architecture reference for the Nestor VM (.nbc format and opcodes).
Outlines future phases and details the Phase 2 Nestor VM implementation milestone.

architecture: Stack-based virtual machine (NVM) using mapped .nbc bytecode via mmap.
Chained arena allocation model passing Arena* context recursively.
Zero-copy string representation using length-delimited StringView structs.

decisions.decision: Update docs to designate NVM as the default execution engine
decisions.reason: Aligns the engineering goals to sunset the AST-based DAG runner and execute via stack opcodes.

decisions.decision: Deactivate AST execution fallback in documentation but preserve it in main.c code for now
decisions.reason: Ensures current regression tests remain passing while VM execute loop is built out.

discoveries: Header shifts or changes in src/include/ast.h require make clean to reset all compiled offsets and avoid ASan segmentation faults.
Unit tests running criterion inside sandbox require BypassSandbox: true or state lock files will fail to release or permission errors will occur.
assumptions: The VM execute loop (nvm.c) will be expanded opcode-by-opcode using curl/JSONata integration structures already verified in the DAG runner.
rejected_approaches: Changing the default execution loop in main.c immediately to NVM was rejected because the VM execution loop is currently a stub and would break E2E integration tests.
known_limitations: NVM is currently only stubbed for OP_RESOLVE, OP_FORK, OP_JOIN, and OP_CALL_PROVIDER.
conversation_context: Preserve function folding rules in C files (/*#region*/ ... /*#endregion*/).

performed: Passed all 64 unit tests in test_runner_unit
Passed all 22 E2E tests in test_runner_e2e
